items.title: Cardano’s IOG warns users to avoid YouTube channel amid giveaway scam
items.snippet: Input Output Group told users to avoid its YouTube channel after it began livestreaming a suspected AI-manipulated Charles Hoskinson video promising to “double your wealth.”

items.title: World launches self-custodial ‘super app’ World Money
items.snippet: World Money is rolling out across more than 150 countries, combining stablecoin payments, digital asset rewards and trading in a self-custodial app.

items.title: Bank of Japan raises interest rates by 25 basis points. Bitcoin tops $77,000
items.snippet: The yen declined and BTC rose after the BOJ hiked rates to the highest level in 31 years.

items.title: US sanctions Iran’s BitBank, saying it processes ‘Hormuz Safe’ Bitcoin payments
items.snippet: US Treasury says the Iranian exchange processed payments received through Iran’s Strait of Hormuz maritime scheme and helped move hundreds of millions of dollars in Bitcoin to the IRGC.
